2608.30410.title: SePArate: Segmenting Patterns from Defects in Wafer Manufacturing Using Weak Supervision
2608.30410.paper_summary: In semiconductor manufacturing, defect analysis is essential, but manual inspection cannot scale. However, existing automated inspection methods remain insufficient for root-cause analysis and process optimization. To this end, we present SePArate, a weakly supervised wafer defect segmentation method. SePArate enables pixel-level separation of patterns by leveraging only image-level annotations. It consists of a three-phase training: encoder pretraining, knowledge transfer to learn spatial cues, and training on synthetic mixed-defect data for accurate segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that SePArate outperforms the baselines.
2608.30410.paper_summary_zh: 在半導體製造中，缺陷分析至關重要，但手動檢查無法擴展。<lb/>然而，現有的自動檢查方法在根本原因分析和過程優化方面仍然不足。<lb/>為此，我們提出了SePArate，一種弱監督的晶圓缺陷分割方法。<lb/>SePArate通過僅利用圖像級註釋實現了像素級的模式分離。<lb/>它由三個階段的訓練組成：編碼器預訓練、知識轉移以學習空間線索，以及在合成混合缺陷數據上進行準確的分割訓練。<lb/>實驗表明，SePArate的表現超過了基準。
